paragraphs: He is mentioned in Shekalim, chapter 5, mishnah 1, as having been appointed in the Temple over the curtain.[^1]

notes.text: The Torat Emet digital text of Mishnah Shekalim 5:1 explicitly lists untitled Elazar over the curtains. The source’s untitled heading and curtain office remain literal, without transferring a title or importing the list’s other officials.
